context: Tests whether the agent correctly follows ADR lifecycle conventions when documenting an architecture decision change: storing ADRs in the right directory with the right naming scheme, using proper frontmatter fields (including supersedes/superseded_by), structuring the body correctly, and avoiding prohibited content.

checklist.name: ADR directory location
checklist.description: All ADR files are stored under docs/adr/ at the project root

checklist.name: File naming pattern
checklist.description: Both ADR filenames follow the NNNN-kebab-slug.md pattern with a 4-digit zero-padded monotonic number (e.g. 0001-choose-sqlite.md, 0002-migrate-to-postgresql.md)

checklist.name: Two separate ADR files
checklist.description: Two distinct ADR files exist under docs/adr/ — one for the original SQLite decision and one for the PostgreSQL decision — rather than a single edited file

checklist.name: Original ADR status superseded
checklist.description: The first/original ADR has `status: superseded` in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Original ADR superseded_by field
checklist.description: The first/original ADR has a `superseded_by:` field populated with the filename of the new ADR (not null)

checklist.name: New ADR supersedes field
checklist.description: The new/PostgreSQL ADR has a `supersedes:` field populated with the filename of the original ADR (not null)

checklist.name: New ADR status valid
checklist.description: The new/PostgreSQL ADR has `status:` set to either `proposed` or `accepted` (not superseded or any other value)

checklist.name: Required frontmatter fields
checklist.description: Both ADR files include all five required frontmatter fields: title, status, date, supersedes, superseded_by

checklist.name: ADR date field present
checklist.description: Both ADR files have a `date:` field in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD)

checklist.name: Body section order
checklist.description: The new ADR body contains sections in this order: Context appears before Decision, Decision appears before any Alternatives considered section, Alternatives considered (if present) appears before Consequences

checklist.name: No ordered task lists in ADR
checklist.description: Neither ADR contains ordered step-by-step task lists in the body (e.g. numbered lists of the form '1. Do X, 2. Do Y' describing actions to take)

checklist.name: No test/verification content in ADR
checklist.description: Neither ADR body contains sections or content labelled as verification steps, test lists, or progress state markers (words like 'done', 'blocked', 'TODO' as progress indicators)
